summary.en: By about 3200 BCE Uruk was the largest settlement in southern Mesopotamia and has been called the first city in world history. Some of the earliest known writing comes from here. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 约公元前 3200 年，乌鲁克是美索不达米亚南部最大的聚落，被称作世界历史上的第一座城市。已知最早的一批文字就出自这里。今天在伊拉克。

detail.en: The Metropolitan Museum of Art explains the first writing here by the bookkeeping of large temple estates, recorded on clay tablets; other authors stress trade, and the Met notes that early writing may have existed as early in Syria and Turkey. Uruk is now part of the World Heritage Site 'The Ahwar of Southern Iraq', listed in 2016.
detail.zh: 美国大都会艺术博物馆认为，这里最早的文字来自大神庙田产的记账，记在泥板上；也有作者强调贸易的推动。大都会博物馆还指出，叙利亚和土耳其一带可能同样早就有了早期文字。乌鲁克今天属于世界遗产“伊拉克南部的阿瓦尔”，2016 年列入名录。

summary.en: About 3000 BCE Upper and Lower Egypt became one kingdom with its capital at Memphis. Dates differ between sources. Today in Egypt.
summary.zh: 约公元前 3000 年，上埃及和下埃及合为一个王国，以孟菲斯为都城。各来源的年份不一。今天在埃及。

detail.en: By tradition King Menes, also called Narmer, joined Upper and Lower Egypt and founded Memphis. Britannica places the unification in the third millennium BCE; UNESCO calls Memphis the first capital of ancient Egypt. Memphis and its pyramid fields from Giza to Dahshur became a World Heritage Site in 1979.
detail.zh: 按传统说法，美尼斯王（也叫纳尔迈）统一了上下埃及，建立孟菲斯。《不列颠百科全书》把统一放在公元前 3 千纪；联合国教科文组织称孟菲斯为古埃及的第一个首都。孟菲斯及其从吉萨到达赫舒尔的金字塔群，1979 年列为世界遗产。

title.en: The Great Death Pit at Ur

summary.en: In the Royal Cemetery of Ur, one pit held the bodies of 74 people, most of them young women, buried with a royal burial. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 乌尔王陵墓地的一个坑里，埋着 74 人，大多是年轻女子，与一座王室墓葬同葬。今天在伊拉克。

detail.en: The Royal Cemetery of Ur dates from the Early Dynastic period, about 2600 to 2350 BCE. The Penn Museum describes the 'Great Death Pit' as holding the remains of 74 sacrificial victims, mostly elaborately dressed young women; 74 is the count for this one pit, not for the whole cemetery. The excavator, Leonard Woolley, thought they had taken poison and gone to their deaths willingly. CT scans of two of the skulls point instead to blows to the head. Whether they went willingly is not known. The marker is at Ur.
detail.zh: 乌尔王陵墓地属于早王朝时期，约公元前 2600 年至前 2350 年。宾夕法尼亚大学博物馆说，“大死亡坑”里有 74 名作为祭祀牺牲的人的遗骸，大多是衣饰华丽的年轻女子；74 是这一个坑的数字，不是整个墓地的。发掘者伍利认为，他们服毒而死，是自愿殉葬的。对其中两个头骨的 CT 扫描却显示，死因可能是头部受到击打。他们是否自愿，今天无从得知。标记放在乌尔。

summary.en: Mohenjo-daro, by the Indus, is one of the two largest cities of the Indus civilisation, with tens of thousands of people by modern estimates. Today in Pakistan.
summary.zh: 印度河边的摩亨佐-达罗，是印度河文明最大的两座城市之一，按现代估计住着几万人。今天在巴基斯坦。

detail.en: Estimates of its population range from about 20,000 (IGNOU) to about 41,000 (Britannica). The lower town was laid out by strict rules (UNESCO); most houses had small bathrooms and, like the streets, drains (Britannica). The Great Bath covers about 83 square metres, roughly 12 by 7 metres, and lies about 2.5 metres below the pavement around it; what it was used for is not known for certain. On the bricks the sources differ: UNESCO's page says both that the city was built of unbaked brick and that it was mostly baked brick, and Britannica describes mud brick with towers of baked brick. The city was flooded more than once. A World Heritage Site since 1980.
detail.zh: 人口估计从约 2 万（英迪拉·甘地国立开放大学）到约 4.1 万（《不列颠百科全书》）不等。下城按严格的规则布局（联合国教科文组织）；大多数房屋有小浴室，房屋和街道都有排水沟（《不列颠百科全书》）。大浴场面积约 83 平方米，大约 12 米长、7 米宽，比四周的铺地低约 2.5 米，用途至今不能确定。用的是什么砖，来源说法不一：联合国教科文组织的页面一处说全用未烧的砖，一处说多用烧砖；《不列颠百科全书》说是泥砖，塔楼用烧砖。这座城市曾多次遭受洪水。1980 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: About 2550 BCE the Great Pyramid was built at Giza for King Khufu. It was originally about 147 metres high. Today in Egypt.
summary.zh: 约公元前 2550 年，吉萨建起为胡夫王修的大金字塔，原高约 147 米。今天在埃及。

detail.en: Khufu reigned from about 2551 to 2528 BCE. The Greek writers Herodotus, in the fifth century BCE, and Diodorus, in the first, gave 100,000 men in three-month shifts over 20 years and 360,000 men for nearly 20 years. Neither says the builders were slaves; the numbers are theirs. Archaeologists have found a large settlement at Giza where labourers, craftsmen, managers and officials lived.
detail.zh: 胡夫约在公元前 2551 年至前 2528 年在位。希腊作者希罗多德（公元前 5 世纪）说，每 10 万人一队、每队三个月，修了 20 年；狄奥多罗斯（公元前 1 世纪）说，36 万人干了将近 20 年。两人都没有说修建者是奴隶，数字是他们自己的说法。考古学家在吉萨发现了一处大型聚落，住着劳工、工匠、管理者和官员。

title.zh: 阿卡德征服苏美尔诸城

summary.en: About 2300 BCE the kings of Akkad, to the north, brought the rival Sumerian cities under their rule by conquest. Experts' dates differ by decades. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 约公元前 2300 年，北边阿卡德的国王用武力把互相竞争的苏美尔各城纳入统治。专家给出的年份相差几十年。今天在伊拉克。

detail.en: The Metropolitan Museum of Art dates the Akkadian period to about 2350 to 2150 BCE, with King Sargon reigning from about 2340 to 2285 BCE; another scheme of dates places these events several decades later. Akkad's capital, Agade, has not yet been found, so the marker is at Nippur, in the middle of Sumer.
detail.zh: 美国大都会艺术博物馆把阿卡德时期定在约公元前 2350 年至前 2150 年，萨尔贡王约在公元前 2340 年至前 2285 年在位；另一种年代体系把这些事排在晚几十年的位置。阿卡德的都城阿加德至今没有找到，所以标记放在苏美尔中部的尼普尔。

title.en: Ur-Nammu: the ziggurat and the law code

summary.en: About 2100 BCE King Ur-Nammu of Ur built the great ziggurat there; the oldest law code yet found carries his name. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 约公元前 2100 年，乌尔的国王乌尔纳姆在那里建起大塔庙；迄今发现最古老的法典以他命名。今天在伊拉克。

detail.en: Britannica gives Ur-Nammu's reign as 2112 to 2095 BCE, the first king of the Third Dynasty of Ur; other schemes of dates differ. The code deals with witchcraft, runaway slaves and bodily injuries. Some scholars think it was really issued by his son Shulgi, which is why it is described as the code that carries his name.
detail.zh: 据《不列颠百科全书》，乌尔纳姆是乌尔第三王朝的第一位国王，在位时间为公元前 2112 年至前 2095 年；其他年代体系的年份有所不同。这部法典涉及巫术、逃亡的奴隶和人身伤害。有学者认为它其实是他的儿子舒尔吉颁布的，所以这里说“以他命名”。

summary.en: From about 1900 BCE the great Indus cities decline; by about 1700 BCE they have come to an end, and why is still debated.
summary.zh: 约公元前 1900 年起，印度河的大城市逐渐衰落，约公元前 1700 年已告终，原因至今仍有争论。

detail.en: One explanation comes from a 2012 study of old river beds: as the monsoon weakened, the monsoon-fed rivers of the Harappan plain dried up or became seasonal, and places along them became harder to live in. The mature period is often dated about 2600 to 1900 BCE; Britannica gives core dates of about 2500 to 1700 BCE. The marker stands at Mohenjo-daro.
detail.zh: 一种解释来自 2012 年的一项古河床研究：季风减弱后，哈拉帕平原上靠季风补给的河流干涸或变成季节河，沿河一带越来越难住人。成熟期常被定在约公元前 2600 年至前 1900 年；《不列颠百科全书》给出的核心年代是约公元前 2500 年至前 1700 年。标记放在摩亨佐-达罗。

summary.en: Erlitou, a large, neatly laid-out town with a walled palace area, where the earliest known bronze ritual vessels were cast. Today in Henan, China.
summary.zh: 二里头是一座布局整齐、有围墙宫殿区的大城，已知最早的青铜礼器就铸在这里。今天在中国河南。

detail.en: It dates from the early second millennium BCE; the marker's date is approximate. Since its discovery in 1959, archaeologists in China have debated whether it belonged to the Xia or the early Shang. Bronze was used earlier elsewhere; Erlitou is where it was first used to cast ritual vessels.
detail.zh: 它的年代在公元前 2 千纪早期，标记的年份只是约数。自 1959 年发现以来，中国考古学界一直在争论它属于夏还是早商。别处更早就用青铜，二里头是已知最早用青铜铸造礼器的地方。

summary.en: At Yin Xu, the late Shang capital, records of divination carved on bones and turtle shells are the earliest known Chinese writing. Today near Anyang, China.
summary.zh: 在晚商都城殷墟，刻在兽骨和龟甲上的占卜记录，是已知最早的汉字。今天在中国安阳附近。

detail.en: Yin Xu was the capital from about 1300 to 1046 BCE; the oracle bones go back to about 1300 BCE, and the marker's date is approximate. About 150,000 inscribed shoulder blades and turtle shells have been found there since the end of the 19th century (ICOMOS). A World Heritage Site since 2006.
detail.zh: 殷墟约从公元前 1300 年到前 1046 年是都城；甲骨文早到约公元前 1300 年，标记的年份只是约数。19 世纪末以来，这里共出土约 15 万片刻字的肩胛骨和龟甲（国际古迹遗址理事会）。2006 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: In the royal tombs area at Yin Xu, pits hold human remains that UNESCO says are considered to have been sacrificial victims. Today near Anyang, China.
summary.zh: 殷墟王陵区的坑里埋着人骨，联合国教科文组织说，这些人被认为是祭祀的牺牲。今天在中国安阳附近。

detail.en: Among the royal tombs are more than 2,000 smaller graves, most of them sacrificial pits, believed to hold people the Shang kings offered to their ancestors (ICOMOS). In the royal cemetery at Xibeigang, excavators found more than 1,000 sacrificial pits with up to 12 skeletons each. The oracle bones mention at least 14,197 human victims, a scholar's count of mentions that may count one event more than once; at least 7,426 of them are named as Qiang, a people outside the Shang state (Shelach 1996).
detail.zh: 在几座大王陵之间，有 2,000 多座小墓，大多是祭祀坑，被认为埋的是商王献给祖先的人（国际古迹遗址理事会）。在西北冈王陵区，考古学者发掘出 1,000 多个祭祀坑，每坑最多 12 具人骨。甲骨文提到的人牲至少 14,197 人，这是一位学者统计的提及次数，同一件事可能被算了不止一次；其中至少 7,426 人被写明是羌人，他们是商国之外的人群（Shelach 1996）。

summary.en: About 508–507 BCE (the usual modern dating), Cleisthenes' reforms reorganised the citizens of Athens into ten tribes and began rule by an assembly of citizens. Only free adult men whose parents were both citizens could take part.
summary.zh: 约公元前 508 至前 507 年（现代学者通行的推算），克里斯提尼的改革把雅典公民重新编成十个部落，开始由公民大会治理。只有父母都是公民的自由成年男子才能参加。

detail.en: Aristotle's Athenian Constitution dates the reform by the year of the archon Isagoras, not by a number; 508–507 BCE is a modern calculation. The rule that a citizen's parents must both be citizens came later, from a law proposed by Pericles. In the 4th century BCE there were perhaps 30,000 adult male citizens, a modern estimate. The Acropolis of Athens has been a World Heritage Site since 1987.
detail.zh: 亚里士多德的《雅典政制》只说改革在伊萨哥拉斯任执政官那年，没有写年份；公元前 508 至前 507 年是现代人的推算。“父母都须是公民”的规定是后来伯里克利提议的法律定下的。公元前 4 世纪，成年男性公民大约 3 万人，这是现代学者的估计。雅典卫城 1987 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: About 449 BCE (the traditional date), Rome, by then a republic that elected two consuls for one year at a time, engraved its laws on bronze tablets and put them on public display: the Twelve Tables.
summary.zh: 约公元前 449 年（传统说法），已是共和国、每年选出两名任期一年的执政官的罗马，把法律刻在铜板上公开展出，这就是十二铜表法。

detail.en: The Roman historian Livy, writing about 430 years later, says the laws of the ten-man commission were engraved and publicly exhibited, and that in his day they were still the source of all public and private law. The dates 451–449 BCE come from Livy's tradition, not from a record of the time.
detail.zh: 罗马史家李维在约四百三十年后写道：十人委员会制定的法律被刻好公开展出，到他那个时代，仍是一切公法和私法的源头。公元前 451 至前 449 年这些年份来自李维记下的传统，不是当时的记录。

summary.en: In June 323 BCE Alexander of Macedon fell ill and died at Babylon. He had overthrown the Persian Empire and ruled from Greece and Egypt to the edge of India.
summary.zh: 公元前 323 年 6 月，马其顿的亚历山大在巴比伦病逝。他推翻了波斯帝国，统治的地方从希腊、埃及一直到印度的边缘。

detail.en: His conquests laid the foundations of the Hellenistic world, in which Greek culture spread across western Asia and Egypt, while the peoples he conquered lost their own rulers. The marker is at the site of Babylon, in today's Iraq.
detail.zh: 他的征服为“希腊化世界”打下基础，希腊文化由此传到西亚和埃及，被征服的民族则失去了自己的君主。标记在巴比伦遗址，今天在伊拉克。

summary.en: About 321 BCE the Maurya dynasty comes to power, ruling from Pataliputra; its empire is the first to cover most of the Indian subcontinent. Pataliputra is today's Patna, India.
summary.zh: 约公元前 321 年，孔雀王朝兴起，以华氏城为都，成为第一个统治印度次大陆大部分地方的帝国。华氏城就是今天印度的巴特那。

detail.en: Britannica gives about 321 to 185 BCE; other works put the founding in 322 or 320 BCE.
detail.zh: 《不列颠百科全书》写约公元前 321 年至前 185 年；也有著作把建立定在前 322 年或前 320 年。

summary.en: In 312 BCE the censor Appius Claudius brought the first aqueduct, the Aqua Appia, into Rome. Until then the city drank from the Tiber, wells and springs.
summary.zh: 公元前 312 年，监察官阿庇乌斯·克劳狄乌斯把第一条水道“阿庇亚水道”引进罗马。在此之前，全城用的是台伯河、水井和泉水。

detail.en: Aqueducts carried water by gravity alone. The architect Vitruvius advised a fall of at least half a foot in every hundred feet: a slope gentle enough to keep the water moving without tearing the channel.
detail.zh: 水道只靠重力输水。建筑师维特鲁威建议，水渠每一百尺至少要有半尺的落差：坡度很缓，水能一直流动，又不会冲坏渠道。

summary.en: Ashoka conquers Kalinga; in his Thirteenth Rock Edict he says 100,000 people were killed and 150,000 carried away, and many more died. Kalinga is today's Odisha, India.
summary.zh: 阿育王征服羯陵伽；他在第十三摩崖法敕里说，十万人被杀、十五万人被掳走，死去的人还要多得多。羯陵伽就是今天印度的奥迪沙邦一带。

detail.en: These are the king's own figures; no record from the Kalinga side is known. The edict says Brahmans, ascetics and householders also suffered, and that the king feels deep remorse. It dates the war only as eight years after his coronation; about 260 BCE is a modern reckoning. The marker shows the region, not a battlefield. The edict is not carved at Dhauli: there, and at Jaugada, two special edicts to the officials of Kalinga take the place of edicts XI to XIII.
detail.zh: 这些是国王自己的数字，羯陵伽一方没有留下任何记录。法敕说，婆罗门、苦行者和居家的百姓也一同受害，国王深感悔恨。法敕只说战争在国王灌顶后第八年，“约公元前 260 年”是后人的推算。标记表示这一地区，不是战场。第十三章没有刻在道里：那里和 Jaugada 刻的是两道写给羯陵伽官员的特别敕令，取代了第十一至十三章。

summary.en: Qin conquers the last of the Zhou-era states and rules one empire from Xianyang, making writing, weights and measures, and the width of roads the same everywhere. Today in China.
summary.zh: 秦灭掉最后一个诸侯国，以咸阳为都建立统一的帝国，统一了文字、度量衡和道路的宽度。今天在中国。

detail.en: The Qin dynasty lasted from 221 to 207 BCE. Under Qin Shi Huang, earlier walls in the north were joined together, about 220 BCE (UNESCO). Britannica says the heavy taxes for the building projects and wars took their toll. How the conquest happened, and the people who did the building, are in the Spring and Autumn and Warring States topic.
detail.zh: 秦朝从公元前 221 年延续到前 207 年。约公元前 220 年，秦始皇把北方早先的城墙连接起来（联合国教科文组织）。《不列颠百科全书》说，为修建工程和打仗征收的沉重赋税，使百姓不堪重负。秦怎样灭六国、谁在修这些工程，见“春秋战国”主题。

title.en: The decree on the Rosetta Stone

summary.en: In 196 BCE a decree of King Ptolemy V, apparently composed by priests at Memphis, was written in three scripts: hieroglyphs, demotic and Greek. Today in Egypt.
summary.zh: 公元前 196 年，托勒密五世的一道诏令，看来出自孟菲斯的祭司之手，用三种文字写成：圣书体、世俗体和希腊文。今天在埃及。

detail.en: A copy carved on stone was found much later at Rosetta, in the Nile delta. Britannica says that reading the hieroglyphs with its help was largely the work of Thomas Young and Jean-François Champollion; Champollion began to publish on it in 1821 and 1822. The marker is at Memphis, where the decree was composed, not at Rosetta, where the stone was found.
detail.zh: 刻着这道诏令的一块石碑，很久以后在尼罗河三角洲的罗塞塔被发现。《不列颠百科全书》说，借助它读懂圣书体，主要是托马斯·杨和商博良的工作；商博良在 1821 年至 1822 年开始发表这方面的论文。标记放在诏令写成的孟菲斯，而不是发现石碑的罗塞塔。

summary.en: In 146 BCE the Roman general Mummius destroyed the Greek city of Corinth. Pausanias, writing about 300 years later, says most of the people found in the city were killed and the women and children sold into slavery.
summary.zh: 公元前 146 年，罗马将军穆米乌斯摧毁希腊城市科林斯。约三百年后的保萨尼亚斯说，城里找到的人大多被杀，妇女和儿童被卖为奴隶。

detail.en: No count of the dead survives. The historian Polybius, who was there, is quoted by the geographer Strabo: he saw paintings thrown on the ground and Roman soldiers playing draughts on them.
detail.zh: 没有留下死亡人数。当时在场的史家波利比乌斯，经地理学家斯特拉波转述说，他看见画被扔在地上，罗马士兵在画上下跳棋。

title.zh: 斯巴达克斯起义后的钉十字架

summary.en: In 71 BCE Rome crushed the revolt of runaway slaves led by Spartacus. Appian, writing about 200 years later, says about 6,000 captured rebels were crucified along the road between Capua and Rome.
summary.zh: 公元前 71 年，罗马镇压了斯巴达克斯领导的逃亡奴隶起义。约两百年后的阿庇安说，约 6,000 名被俘的起义者沿着卡普阿与罗马之间的路被钉上十字架。

detail.en: The revolt lasted from 73 to 71 BCE. Appian writes the same way about the rebels' side: Spartacus sacrificed 300 Roman prisoners to the dead rebel leader Crixus, and had a Roman prisoner crucified in front of his own troops. The two English translations of Appian give the road in opposite directions, so none is given here. The marker is at today's Capua.
detail.zh: 起义从公元前 73 年持续到前 71 年。阿庇安也用同样的方式记下起义一方的事：斯巴达克斯把 300 名罗马俘虏献祭给战死的起义首领克雷克斯，又当着自己军队的面把一名罗马俘虏钉上十字架。阿庇安的两种英译对这条路的方向说法相反，这里不写方向。标记在今天的卡普阿。

summary.en: In 30 BCE, after Octavian defeated Mark Antony and Queen Cleopatra, Egypt became a province of Rome. Today in Egypt.
summary.zh: 公元前 30 年，屋大维打败马克·安东尼和克娄巴特拉女王，埃及成为罗马的一个行省。今天在埃及。

detail.en: The Roman historian Cassius Dio, writing more than two centuries later, says Octavian made Egypt tributary and put Cornelius Gallus in charge of it. Some histories end ancient Egypt here; others end it in 332 BCE, with Alexander's conquest. The marker is at Alexandria, on the coast of the delta.
detail.zh: 两百多年后的罗马史家卡西乌斯·狄奥说，屋大维让埃及向罗马纳贡，派科尔涅利乌斯·加卢斯掌管。有的史书把古埃及的结束定在这一年，也有的定在公元前 332 年亚历山大征服埃及之时。标记放在三角洲海边的亚历山大。

summary.en: In 27 BCE Octavian took the name Augustus. He became the first emperor of Rome, and the republic of elected consuls gave way to rule by one man.
summary.zh: 公元前 27 年，屋大维获得“奥古斯都”的称号，成为罗马的第一位皇帝。选举执政官的共和国，变成了由一个人统治的帝国。

detail.en: Historians later called the long, comparatively quiet period from Augustus to Marcus Aurelius, who reigned until 180 CE, the Pax Romana, the Roman Peace.
detail.zh: 后来的史家把从奥古斯都到马可·奥勒留（在位到公元 180 年）这一段相对太平的漫长时期，称为“罗马和平”。

summary.en: By tradition, about 105 CE, Cai Lun, an official at the Han court, makes paper from tree bark, hemp, old rags and fishing nets. Today in China.
summary.zh: 按传统说法，约公元 105 年，汉朝宫廷官员蔡伦用树皮、麻头、破布和旧渔网造出了纸。今天在中国。

detail.en: Cai Lun served at the Eastern Han court, whose capital was Luoyang; the marker is there, as no source read names the place where he made paper. Britannica says he is traditionally credited with the invention, and that papermaking can be traced to about 105.
detail.zh: 蔡伦在东汉宫廷任职，东汉的都城是洛阳；标记放在洛阳，因为读到的来源没有写他在哪里造纸。《不列颠百科全书》说，传统上认为是他发明了纸，造纸可以追溯到约公元 105 年。

title.en: Óc Eo, a port of Funan
title.zh: 扶南的港口 Óc Eo（俄厄）

summary.en: A port among canal-linked settlements in the Mekong Delta, flourishing between about the 1st and 6th centuries CE; Roman gold coins and medals, Han bronze mirrors and Persian lamps have been found there. Today in Viet Nam.
summary.zh: 湄公河三角洲上由运河相连的一群聚落中的港口，约在公元 1 至 6 世纪兴盛；这里出土过罗马金币和金章、汉代铜镜和波斯油灯。今天在越南。

detail.en: The list of finds comes from the text Viet Nam submitted to UNESCO for its Tentative List, not from a UNESCO assessment. Óc Eo is linked with the land Chinese writers called Funan.
detail.zh: 出土物的清单来自越南向联合国教科文组织提交的预备名单文字，不是教科文组织的评估。Óc Eo 被认为属于中国作者所说的“扶南”。

title.en: Kang Tai and Zhu Ying visit Funan

summary.en: In the mid-3rd century two envoys of the Chinese state of Wu visit a land Chinese records call Funan; their reports survive only as passages in later Chinese histories. Today in Cambodia and Viet Nam.
summary.zh: 3 世纪中叶，中国吴国的两位使者到访中国史书称为“扶南”的地方；他们的记录只以片段保存在后来的中国史书里。今天在柬埔寨和越南。

detail.en: The mission is usually dated to about 244–247 CE. Where Funan's centre or centres lay is not settled; the marker is at Angkor Borei in southern Cambodia only to show the region.
detail.zh: 这次出使通常定在约公元 244 至 247 年。扶南的中心在哪里（或者有几个中心）并无定论；标记放在柬埔寨南部的吴哥波雷，只是表示大致地区。

summary.en: 476 CE is the year usually given for the end of the Roman Empire in the west, when its last emperor, Romulus Augustulus, was deposed. The eastern empire lasted until 1453.
summary.zh: 公元 476 年，西罗马最后一位皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都路斯被废黜，人们通常以这一年作为西罗马帝国的结束。东罗马帝国一直延续到 1453 年。

detail.en: 476 is a conventional date: the western empire had been losing land for decades. The eastern half, ruled from Constantinople, ended when the Ottomans took the city in 1453. The marker is at Rome, the old capital; the map of 400 CE shows only the western empire.
detail.zh: 476 年是惯例上的年份：西罗马帝国此前几十年一直在失去土地。以君士坦丁堡为都城的东半部，到 1453 年奥斯曼人攻下这座城才结束。标记放在旧都罗马；公元 400 年的地图只画出西罗马帝国。

summary.en: The Chinese monk Yijing leaves Guangzhou on a Persian ship in November 671 and spends six months in Srivijaya studying, on his way to India. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 671 年 11 月，中国僧人义净乘波斯船离开广州，前往印度途中在室利佛逝学习了六个月。今天在印度尼西亚。

detail.en: Yijing's writings are the first known mention of Srivijaya. He stopped there again on his way home between 685 and 689. Surveys west of Palembang make it practically certain that this was Srivijaya's heartland in the 7th to 10th centuries.
detail.zh: 义净的著作是室利佛逝已知最早的记载。685 至 689 年回国途中，他又在那里停留。巨港以西的考古调查表明，这里几乎可以肯定是 7 至 10 世纪室利佛逝的中心。

title.en: A Khmer inscription with a zero

summary.en: A Khmer stone inscription, known as K-127, is dated 605 in the Saka era, which is 683 CE. The zero in 605 is one of the earliest dated zeros known. Today in Cambodia.
summary.zh: 一块编号 K-127 的高棉石碑，年份是塞种纪元 605 年，也就是公元 683 年。605 里的零，是已知最早有日期的零之一。今天在柬埔寨。

detail.en: A French team found the stone in 1891 near the village of Sambor on the Mekong River. This is not the same place as Sambor Prei Kuk. In 1931 the French scholar Georges Cœdès read the middle sign of 605 as a zero. The marker is at Sambour district, Kratie province; the sources used here do not give the exact find-spot.
detail.zh: 1891 年，一支法国考古队在湄公河边的三波村附近发现这块石碑；这里和三波坡雷古不是同一个地方。1931 年，法国学者赛代斯认定 605 中间的符号是零。标记在桔井省三波县；这里所用的来源没有给出确切的出土地点。

summary.en: A stone near Palembang dated about 683 is one of the oldest known writings in Old Malay, in a script from India. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 巨港附近一块约 683 年的碑，用源自印度的文字刻成，是已知最早的古马来语文字之一。今天在印度尼西亚。

detail.en: The date reads Saka 605, that is 683 CE; some scholars read 682. The stone was found in 1920 south-west of Palembang. Srivijaya's own records are inscriptions like this one, almost all from the second half of the 7th century.
detail.zh: 碑上的纪年是塞种纪元 605 年，即公元 683 年，也有学者读作 682 年。石碑 1920 年在巨港西南发现。室利佛逝自己留下的记录就是这样的碑文，几乎都在 7 世纪下半叶。

title.zh: 阇耶跋摩二世自称转轮王

summary.en: The Khmer king Jayavarman II begins to rule as a universal king, the usual starting date of the Khmer Empire. Today in Cambodia.
summary.zh: 高棉国王阇耶跋摩二世开始以“转轮王”（世界之主）的身份统治，通常以这一年作为高棉帝国的开始。今天在柬埔寨。

detail.en: The date 802 comes from an inscription written about two centuries later. Jayavarman II moved his capital several times; the marker is on Phnom Kulen, the holy mountain north of Angkor where one of his capitals, Mahendraparvata, stood.
detail.zh: 802 年这个年份出自大约两百年后的一块碑文。阇耶跋摩二世几次迁都；标记放在吴哥以北的圣山荔枝山，他的都城之一摩醯因陀罗波伐多就在那里。

summary.en: About 826–830 CE a ship, most likely Arab, sinks a few kilometres off Belitung with close to 60,000 pieces of Chinese ceramics; it probably sailed from Yangzhou or Guangzhou. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 约公元 826 至 830 年，一艘很可能是阿拉伯的船在勿里洞岛外几公里处沉没，船上有近 6 万件中国瓷器；它很可能从扬州或广州出发。今天在印度尼西亚。

detail.en: Fishermen found it in 1998 in about 17 metres of water. One bowl seems to carry a date equal to 826. The Indonesian government authorised a salvage company to recover the cargo; some have argued that commercial salvage was not the best way to recover such a site. The cargo is on permanent display at the Asian Civilisations Museum in Singapore. Its route is not drawn: the departure port is not known.
detail.zh: 1998 年渔民在水深约 17 米处发现了它。一只碗上似乎刻有相当于 826 年的日期。印度尼西亚政府授权一家打捞公司打捞货物；有人认为商业打捞不是处理这类遗址最好的方式。货物现在新加坡亚洲文明博物馆常设展出。图上不画它的航线，因为出发港并不确定。

title.zh: 标着 868 年的印本经卷

summary.en: A printed scroll of the Diamond Sutra, a Buddhist text in Chinese, is dated 868 CE. It is now in the British Library in London.
summary.zh: 一卷印出来的《金刚经》，是用中文写的佛经，标着公元 868 年。它现在藏在伦敦的大英图书馆。

detail.en: The scroll was printed from carved wooden blocks. It was found in a cave at the Mogao Caves near Dunhuang that had been sealed about the 11th century and was opened in 1900; the explorer Aurel Stein took it to England in 1907. The British Library calls it the world's earliest dated printed book. Today the Mogao Caves are in China.
detail.zh: 这卷经是用刻好的木版印的。它出自敦煌附近莫高窟里的一个洞窟，那个洞大约在 11 世纪被封住，1900 年才被打开；1907 年探险家斯坦因把它带到英国。大英图书馆称它是世界上最早有日期的印本书。莫高窟今天在中国。

summary.en: An inscription in a temple at Gwalior in central India, dated 876 CE, writes the number zero. It is one of the earliest dated zeros known. Today in India.
summary.zh: 印度中部瓜廖尔一座神庙里的铭文，年代是公元 876 年，写出了数字零。它是已知最早有日期的零之一。今天在印度。

detail.en: The zero appears in a measurement of land. A Khmer inscription found at Sambor in Cambodia, dated 683 CE, also has a zero; the Bakhshali manuscript may be older, but its dating is disputed.
detail.zh: 这个零出现在一个土地面积的数字里。柬埔寨三波出土、年代为公元 683 年的高棉碑文也写有零；巴克沙利手稿可能更早，但它的年代有争议。

summary.en: The Chola kingdom of southern India, which saw Srivijaya as an obstacle on the sea route to East Asia, seizes Palembang and carries off its king and treasure. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 印度南部的朱罗王朝把室利佛逝看作通往东亚海路上的障碍，夺取巨港，掳走国王，掠走财宝。今天在印度尼西亚。

detail.en: Chola also attacked other parts of the kingdom. Srivijaya did not end at once: it shrank over the following century and a half, and by the end of the 12th century it was a small kingdom, its place taken by Malayu at Jambi. No casualty figures are known.
detail.zh: 朱罗也进攻了王国的其他地方。室利佛逝并没有立刻灭亡，而是在此后一百五十年里逐渐缩小，到 12 世纪末只剩一个小王国，地位被占碑的末罗瑜取代。伤亡人数没有记载。

summary.en: The temple of Angkor Wat is built in the 12th century under King Suryavarman II, who reigned from about 1113 to about 1150. Today in Cambodia.
summary.zh: 吴哥窟这座寺庙建于 12 世纪苏利耶跋摩二世（约 1113 至约 1150 年在位）治下。今天在柬埔寨。

detail.en: The years shown are the king's reign; the building work is believed to have taken some three decades. Angkor, the whole area of capitals, temples and reservoirs, became a World Heritage Site in 1992; Angkor Wat is one temple in it. UNESCO's Chinese name calls the whole property 吴哥窟.
detail.zh: 图上的年份是国王的在位年；工期据信约三十年。“吴哥”指都城、寺庙和水库所在的整片地区，1992 年列为世界遗产；吴哥窟是其中的一座寺庙。联合国教科文组织的中文名把整个遗产叫作“吴哥窟”。

summary.en: A Khmer invasion takes Vijaya, the capital of Champa, and the Khmer occupy it for four years. Today in Viet Nam.
summary.zh: 高棉军队攻入占婆，攻取都城毗阇耶，占领了四年。今天在越南。

detail.en: Another account says Suryavarman II deposed the Cham king in 1144 and annexed Champa the following year, so the date is also written 1144–45. No casualty figures are known. The marker is at Đồ Bàn, the site of Vijaya.
detail.zh: 另一种说法是苏利耶跋摩二世 1144 年废黜占婆国王，次年吞并占婆，所以年份也写作 1144—1145 年。伤亡人数没有记载。标记在毗阇耶遗址阇槃。

title.en: A Cham fleet takes the Khmer capital
title.zh: 占婆舰队攻取高棉都城

summary.en: A Cham fleet sails up the Mekong into the Tonlé Sap, takes the Khmer capital Yasodharapura at Angkor and destroys it. Today in Cambodia.
summary.zh: 占婆舰队沿湄公河而上，进入洞里萨湖，攻取吴哥的高棉都城耶输陀罗补罗，并将它毁坏。今天在柬埔寨。

detail.en: Within a few years Jayavarman VII drove the Cham out, and he was crowned in 1181. No casualty figures are known.
detail.zh: 几年之内，阇耶跋摩七世把占人赶走，1181 年加冕。伤亡人数没有记载。

summary.en: In the mid-13th century, traditionally in 1238, a local Tai ruler leads a revolt against Khmer rule and founds the kingdom of Sukhothai. Today in Thailand.
summary.zh: 13 世纪中叶，按传统说法在 1238 年，一位本地泰人统治者起兵反抗高棉统治，建立素可泰王国。今天在泰国。

detail.en: UNESCO calls Sukhothai “the capital of the first Kingdom of Siam”; the Historic Town of Sukhothai became a World Heritage Site in 1991. The map shows Sukhothai as a point, not an area: the reach claimed for King Ramkhamhaeng is read by historians as local rulers recognising him, and his inscription's authenticity has been questioned.
detail.zh: 联合国教科文组织称素可泰为“暹罗第一王国的都城”；素可泰历史城镇 1991 年列为世界遗产。地图上素可泰只画成一个点，不画范围：史家把兰甘亨王名下的范围理解为各地统治者承认他的宗主地位，而且他的碑文真伪曾受质疑。

summary.en: About 1293 a prince of East Java, later called Kertarajasa, uses a Mongol army that had come to punish his father-in-law, then drives it out and founds Majapahit. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 约 1293 年，东爪哇王子、后来称克尔塔拉查萨的拉登·威查耶，利用前来惩罚他岳父的蒙古军队，随后把它赶走，建立了满者伯夷。今天在印度尼西亚。

detail.en: The Mongol emperor sent the expedition in 1292, but King Kertanagara had been killed by a rebel, Jayakatwang, before it landed. His son-in-law overthrew Jayakatwang with Mongol help and then turned against the Mongols. The sources read give 1292 and no exact founding day, so the topic writes about 1293. The marker is at Trowulan in East Java, where the Majapahit capital is usually placed; that placing was not checked against a non-Wikipedia source.
detail.zh: 蒙古皇帝 1292 年派出远征军，但国王格尔达纳卡拉在元军登陆前已被叛臣查耶卡湾杀死。他的女婿借助元军推翻查耶卡湾，随后转而攻击元军。所读的来源只写到 1292 年，没有确切的建国日期，所以本主题写“约 1293 年”。标记在东爪哇的特罗乌兰，满者伯夷的都城一般认为在那里；这一点还没有找到维基百科以外的来源核对。

summary.en: The court poet Prapanca writes a poem praising the king that names more than 80 places in the archipelago as Majapahit's territory, among them Tumasik, an old name for Singapore. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 宫廷诗人普腊班扎写下歌颂国王的长诗，把群岛上 80 多个地方列为满者伯夷的属地，其中有新加坡的旧名“淡马锡”。今天在印度尼西亚。

detail.en: The list is a court poem's view: historians disagree whether Majapahit really ruled today's Indonesia and part of Malaysia, or only eastern Java and Bali. The poem has 98 cantos; the list of territories is in cantos 13 to 16. It also describes the king urging his people to keep up the rice fields.
detail.zh: 这份名单是宫廷颂诗的说法：史家对满者伯夷究竟统治了今天的印度尼西亚和马来西亚一部分，还是只统治东爪哇和巴厘，意见不一。全诗共 98 章，属地名单在第 13 至 16 章。诗中还写到国王叮嘱臣民照料好稻田。

summary.en: About 1400 a ruler who left Singapura founds Melaka on the Strait. The Malay Annals call him Iskandar Shah, Portuguese and Chinese records Parameswara. Today in Malaysia.
summary.zh: 约 1400 年，一位离开新加坡拉的统治者在海峡边建立马六甲。《马来纪年》称他为伊斯干达沙，葡萄牙和中国的记载称他为拜里米苏拉。今天在马来西亚。

detail.en: Other dates such as 1402 are also given. The Malay Annals say Singapura fell to a second Javanese attack after a treasurer opened the gate, and Iskandar Shah fled and founded Melaka; Portuguese writers say Parameswara, a prince from Palembang, killed the ruler of Singapura. The two stories cannot be reconciled; scholars think the two names probably mean the same man. Ming records show Melaka sending missions to China from 1405.
detail.zh: 也有 1402 年等其他说法。《马来纪年》说，爪哇人第二次进攻时，一位司库官打开城门，新加坡拉陷落，伊斯干达沙出逃，后来建立马六甲；葡萄牙作者则说，巨港王子拜里米苏拉杀了新加坡拉的统治者。两种说法无法调和；学者认为两个名字很可能指同一个人。明朝记载显示，马六甲从 1405 年起向中国派遣使团。

summary.en: According to Thai chronicles, the kingdom of Ayutthaya attacks Angkor in 1431, the date usually given for the end of the Khmer Empire. Today in Cambodia.
summary.zh: 据泰国编年史，阿瑜陀耶王国在 1431 年攻击吴哥；人们通常把这一年当作高棉帝国结束的年份。今天在柬埔寨。

detail.en: The Khmer court moved south, near today's Phnom Penh. Historians debate how sudden the end was: archaeologists have shown that Angkor Wat was never abandoned and that people went on living in the area, while some scholars point to earlier troubles with water management. No casualty figures are known.
detail.zh: 高棉王室南迁到今天金边附近。史家对结束有多突然有争论：考古学者发现吴哥窟从未被废弃，这一带一直有人居住；也有学者指出，水利系统在更早的时候就已出现问题。伤亡人数没有记载。

summary.en: Sukhothai is absorbed into the kingdom of Ayutthaya. Today in Thailand.
summary.zh: 素可泰并入阿瑜陀耶王国。今天在泰国。

summary.en: Portuguese forces under Afonso de Albuquerque capture Melaka, then the leading trading centre of Southeast Asia. Today in Malaysia.
summary.zh: 阿尔布克尔克率领的葡萄牙军队攻占当时东南亚首屈一指的贸易中心马六甲。今天在马来西亚。

detail.en: Sultan Mahmud Shah fled across the peninsula to Pahang, then founded the kingdom of Johor with his capital on the island of Bintan, south-east of Singapore; the Portuguese destroyed Bintan in 1526. Sources disagree on the month of the capture, so only the year is given.
detail.zh: 苏丹马哈茂德·沙横越半岛逃到彭亨，后来建立柔佛王国，以新加坡东南的民丹岛为都；1526 年葡萄牙人毁了民丹。各来源对攻占的月份说法不同，所以只写年份。

summary.en: In 1896 the Olympic Games were revived, and the first modern Games were held in Athens.
summary.zh: 1896 年，奥运会复兴，第一届现代奥运会在雅典举行。

summary.en: Dholavira, a Harappan city with a carefully planned water system, lived in from about 3000 to 1500 BCE. Today in India.
summary.zh: 多拉维拉是一座有精心设计的用水系统的哈拉帕城市，约公元前 3000 年至前 1500 年有人居住。今天在印度。

detail.en: UNESCO lists evidence of trade with other Harappan cities and with Mesopotamia and the Oman peninsula. A World Heritage Site since 2021.
detail.zh: 联合国教科文组织说，这里有与其他哈拉帕城市以及美索不达米亚、阿曼半岛贸易的证据。2021 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: A Sumerian city-state. Texts from the time of its ruler Gudea record captives brought from Elam. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 苏美尔城邦。它的统治者古地亚时期的文献，记有从埃兰带来的俘虏。今天在伊拉克。

summary.en: A Sumerian city-state in the north of Sumer. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 苏美尔北部的城邦。今天在伊拉克。

summary.en: A Sumerian city in the middle of Sumer. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 位于苏美尔中部的城市。今天在伊拉克。

summary.en: Harappa, by the Ravi, is the other of the two largest Indus cities, and the place where the civilisation was first identified, in 1921. Today in Pakistan.
summary.zh: 拉维河边的哈拉帕，是印度河文明最大的两座城市中的另一座，1921 年人们正是在这里首先认出了这一文明。今天在巴基斯坦。

detail.en: Britannica gives an estimated population of 23,500 to 35,000. The civilisation is also called Harappan after this site.
detail.zh: 《不列颠百科全书》估计这里有 2.35 万至 3.5 万人。这一文明也因此被称为“哈拉帕文明”。

summary.en: A prehistoric village mound from about 1495 BCE with early evidence of settled farming in Southeast Asia, including wet rice growing. A World Heritage Site since 1992. Today in Thailand.
summary.zh: 约公元前 1495 年起的史前聚落土丘，有东南亚定居农业的早期证据，包括水稻种植。1992 年列为世界遗产。今天在泰国。

summary.en: Home of the ancient Olympic Games. The first champion in the records won a sprint race here in 776 BCE.
summary.zh: 古代奥运会的举办地。记录里的第一位冠军，公元前 776 年在这里赢得短跑。

summary.en: The sanctuary where the oracle of Apollo spoke. In the 6th century BCE it was the religious centre of the Greek world. A World Heritage Site since 1987.
summary.zh: 阿波罗神谕所在的圣地。公元前 6 世纪，这里是希腊世界的宗教中心。1987 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: A Greek city-state whose farmland was worked by helots, people held as serfs belonging to the state.
summary.zh: 希腊城邦。斯巴达的田地由希洛人耕种，他们是属于国家的农奴。

detail.en: The historian Thucydides tells how the Spartans picked out about 2,000 helots who had been promised their freedom, and then did away with them; no one knew how each one died.
detail.zh: 史家修昔底德记载，斯巴达人挑出约 2,000 名曾被许诺给予自由的希洛人，随后把他们除掉了，没有人知道他们各自是怎么死的。

summary.en: At Dhauli, in Kalinga, Ashoka's edicts include two special ones addressed to the officials governing the conquered land. Today in Odisha, India.
summary.zh: 在羯陵伽的道里，阿育王的法敕里有两道专门写给治理这片被征服土地的官员的敕令。今天在印度奥迪沙邦。

detail.en: According to the Archaeological Survey of India, the two special edicts replace Rock Edicts XI, XII and XIII here, and are repeated at Jaugada. The figures for the war, in Rock Edict XIII, are therefore not carved at Dhauli.
detail.zh: 据印度考古调查局，这两道特别敕令在这里取代了第十一、十二、十三摩崖法敕，Jaugada 也刻有同样的内容。所以，关于这场战争的数字（第十三章）并不刻在道里。

summary.en: A Roman aqueduct bridge in southern France, almost 50 metres high on three levels, built shortly before the Christian era to carry water to Nîmes. A World Heritage Site since 1985. Today in France.
summary.zh: 法国南部的罗马水道桥，高近 50 米，共三层，建于公元纪年开始前不久，把水送往尼姆。1985 年列入世界遗产。今天在法国。

summary.en: A Roman temple rebuilt about 118–128 CE. Until modern times its dome, about 43 metres across, was the largest ever built.
summary.zh: 罗马的神庙，约公元 118 至 128 年重建。直到近代，它直径约 43 米的穹顶都是世界上建成过的最大穹顶。

summary.en: Tower temples of the 4th to 13th centuries, the religious and political centre of the Champa kingdom, whose culture drew on the Hinduism of India. A World Heritage Site since 1999. Today in Viet Nam.
summary.zh: 4 至 13 世纪的塔庙，是占婆王国的宗教和政治中心；占婆文化在精神上源自印度的印度教。1999 年列为世界遗产。今天在越南。

summary.en: Temples, shrines and waterworks on the Mekong, built from the 5th to the 15th century and mainly linked with the Khmer Empire. A World Heritage Site since 2001. Today in Laos.
summary.zh: 湄公河边的寺庙、神殿和水利工程，建于 5 至 15 世纪，主要与高棉帝国有关。2001 年列为世界遗产。今天在老挝。

summary.en: Ishanapura, capital of Chenla in the late 6th and early 7th centuries; its brick temples mix Hindu ideas from India with local and Buddhist ones. A World Heritage Site since 2017. Today in Cambodia.
summary.zh: 伊奢那补罗，6 世纪末、7 世纪初真腊的都城；它的砖砌寺庙把来自印度的印度教观念与本地信仰、佛教融合在一起。2017 年列为世界遗产。今天在柬埔寨。

summary.en: One of the greatest Buddhist monuments in the world, built in Central Java in the 8th and 9th centuries under the Syailendra dynasty. A World Heritage Site since 1991. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 世界上最伟大的佛教建筑之一，8、9 世纪夏连特拉王朝时建于中爪哇。1991 年列为世界遗产。今天在印度尼西亚。

summary.en: Hindu temples of the 9th century in Java, with Buddhist temples nearby. A World Heritage Site since 1991. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 爪哇 9 世纪的印度教寺庙群，附近还有佛教寺院。1991 年列为世界遗产。今天在印度尼西亚。

summary.en: Temple remains near Jambi on the Batanghari River in Sumatra. Toward the end of the 11th century Jambi took over from Palembang as the leading port kingdom of Sumatra. Today in Indonesia.
summary.zh: 苏门答腊巴当哈里河边、占碑附近的寺庙遗迹。11 世纪末，占碑取代巨港，成为苏门答腊领先的港口王国。今天在印度尼西亚。

summary.en: A sacred Buddhist landscape of temples from the Bagan period, the 11th to 13th centuries. A World Heritage Site since 2019. Today in Myanmar.
summary.zh: 蒲甘时期（11 至 13 世纪）的佛教圣地景观。2019 年列为世界遗产。今天在缅甸。

summary.en: A 14th-century port: the Chinese traveller Wang Dayuan described Danmaxi in 1349, and the Javanese poem of 1365 names Tumasik. Gold ornaments, coins and porcelain have been dug up on Fort Canning Hill. Today in Singapore.
summary.zh: 14 世纪的港口：中国旅行家汪大渊 1349 年记下“单马锡”，1365 年的爪哇长诗写到“淡马锡”。福康宁山上出土过金饰、钱币和瓷器。今天在新加坡。

detail.en: Temasek is not one of the six kingdoms of these chapters. Its story, from the legend of Sang Nila Utama to the fall of Singapura, is told in the background chapter of the topic Singapore, 1819–1965.
detail.zh: 淡马锡不在这两章讲的六个王国之中。从山尼拉乌他玛的传说到新加坡拉的陷落，它的故事在“新加坡 1819–1965”主题的背景章里讲。

summary.en: Founded in 1350, the second capital of the Siamese kingdom, which flourished from the 14th to the 18th century. A World Heritage Site since 1991. Today in Thailand.
summary.zh: 1350 年建城，是暹罗王国的第二个都城，14 至 18 世纪繁荣。1991 年列为世界遗产。今天在泰国。

summary.en: A British colonial tropical botanic garden, created in 1859, that has become a modern scientific institution. A World Heritage Site since 2015. Today in Singapore.
summary.zh: 英国殖民时期建立的热带植物园，1859 年建园，后来发展成现代科研机构。2015 年列入世界遗产。今天在新加坡。

summary.en: Egypt's capital in the Middle and New Kingdoms, with the temples of Karnak and Luxor and, across the river, the Valley of the Kings. A World Heritage Site since 1979. Today in Egypt.
summary.zh: 中王国和新王国时期埃及的都城，有卡纳克和卢克索神庙，河对岸是帝王谷。1979 年列为世界遗产。今天在埃及。

detail.en: The marker is the Wikidata point for Thebes, in the town of Luxor.
detail.zh: 标记是维基数据给底比斯的点，在今天的卢克索城区。

summary.en: Taxila was an important Buddhist centre of learning from the 5th century BCE to the 2nd century CE. Today in Pakistan.
summary.zh: 从公元前 5 世纪到公元 2 世纪，塔克西拉是重要的佛教学术中心。今天在巴基斯坦。

detail.en: A World Heritage Site since 1980. UNESCO's Chinese name is 塔克希拉.
detail.zh: 1980 年列入世界遗产，联合国教科文组织的中文名为“塔克希拉”。

title.en: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor

summary.en: The tomb of the First Emperor of Qin, whose terracotta army was not discovered until 1974. Today near Xi'an, China.
summary.zh: 秦始皇的陵墓，兵马俑直到 1974 年才被发现。今天在中国西安附近。

detail.en: A World Heritage Site since 1987.
detail.zh: 1987 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: Sanchi, which UNESCO calls the oldest Buddhist sanctuary in existence. Today in India.
summary.zh: 桑吉，联合国教科文组织称它为现存最古老的佛教圣地。今天在印度。

detail.en: A World Heritage Site since 1989.
detail.zh: 1989 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: Chang'an, capital of the Western Han, where the Silk Roads to Central Asia began. Today near Xi'an, China.
summary.zh: 长安是西汉的都城，通往中亚的丝绸之路从这里出发。今天在中国西安附近。

detail.en: The city was built in 202 BCE. The Silk Roads of the Chang'an–Tianshan corridor took shape between the 2nd century BCE and the 1st century CE and were used until the 16th century; they became a World Heritage Site in 2014.
detail.zh: 长安城建于公元前 202 年。长安—天山廊道的丝绸之路在公元前 2 世纪到公元 1 世纪之间形成，一直用到 16 世纪；2014 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: A Sumerian city-state, later the capital of the Third Dynasty of Ur, with its ziggurat and royal cemetery. Part of a World Heritage Site since 2016. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 苏美尔城邦，后来是乌尔第三王朝的都城，有塔庙和王陵墓地。2016 年起属于一处世界遗产。今天在伊拉克。

summary.en: A Sumerian city near the old shore of the marshes. Part of a World Heritage Site since 2016. Today in Iraq.
summary.zh: 靠近古代沼泽边缘的苏美尔城市。2016 年起属于一处世界遗产。今天在伊拉克。

summary.en: Nalanda, a Buddhist monastery and centre of learning from the 3rd century BCE to the 13th century CE, which UNESCO calls the most ancient university of the subcontinent. Today in India.
summary.zh: 那烂陀是从公元前 3 世纪延续到公元 13 世纪的佛教寺院和学术中心，联合国教科文组织称它为印度次大陆最古老的大学。今天在印度。

detail.en: A World Heritage Site since 2016.
detail.zh: 2016 年列入世界遗产。

summary.en: A national museum at Empress Place, Singapore. The cargo of the Belitung shipwreck is shown in its Tang Shipwreck Gallery, a permanent exhibition since 2018.
summary.zh: 位于新加坡皇后坊的国家博物馆。黑石号沉船的货物在馆内的唐代沉船展厅展出，2018 年起成为常设展览。
